verdict.rationale: Logseq describes itself as an "open-source knowledge base" [logseq-docs-23]. A community user independently cites "source availability" as a reason for choosing it [logseq-comm-7], and another refers to its open GitHub issue tracker [logseq-comm-20]. Missing for 10: the specific license is never named, there is no direct link to the application source repository, and no documentation covers building or reading the codebase.
